executionEnvironment: local Windows workspace with Docker Desktop Linux engine

behavioralRed.result: The healthy validator rejected mutable action references, incomplete CI gates, absent OCI metadata, missing SBOM/provenance and exact-image smoke, unsafe secret interpolation and a non-deterministic GitOps update surface.
The disposable-image contract initially lacked owned cleanup, exact digest enforcement, application-user MySQL readiness, trigger-migration configuration and credential-safe diagnostic markers.

The real MySQL 8.4.10 smoke first identified MIGRATION_APPLY_FAILED:007:ER_BINLOG_CREATE_ROUTINE_NEED_SUPER; a second real run exposed Windows Docker quote forwarding in the Web deep-link marker. Both causes received focused REDs before correction.

gates.summary: Root installed 234 packages and server installed 98 packages from lockfiles.
Both production dependency audits report zero vulnerabilities.

gates.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-workflows.test.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-workflows.ps1 && node --test scripts/update-gitops-values.test.mjs
gates.summary: Workflow contract and standalone validator pass; all eight deterministic updater tests pass.

gates.command: docker build --file Dockerfile --tag lifeops-web:plan6 . && docker build --file server/Dockerfile --tag lifeops-api:plan6 .
gates.summary: Both exact-base local images build successfully with non-root runtime identities and OCI label contracts.
Fresh MySQL 8.4.10, 16 migrations, API health/readiness/login/goal CRUD, Web health/deep-link fallback, read-only roots, non-root users, clean SIGTERM and owned cleanup pass.

gates.command: npm.cmd test && npm.cmd run test:server && npm.cmd run typecheck && npm.cmd run typecheck:server && npm.cmd run build && npm.cmd run build:server
gates.summary: Frontend passes 84 files/386 tests; server passes 59 files/361 ordinary tests with 50 exact-MySQL cases separately owned; both typechecks and production builds pass.
